identity.identity_basis: A domain-separated SHA-256 key derived from the public TCGA submitter ID preserves patient grouping; the pinned source index retains the mapping. The GDC case UUID, TCGA slide barcode, and GDC file UUID identify the slide asset.

label_limitations: A clean label means no pixel matches the four released AIRAQc palette classes. It does not prove that the slide has no unannotated defect.

scanner.conversion_note: Native GDC Aperio SVS; no registry conversion.
